title: Create run-auditor.role.md — observation-first run state auditor role
description: No run-auditor role file exists. The current reasoning-reviewer.role.md attempts to serve two concerns (reasoning quality and run state observation) in one file, violating the one-concern-per-file AI-first principle. A dedicated run-auditor role is needed to perform observation-first auditing of the complete post-run state (git status, files written, tool return values, rubric verdicts) against a minimal abstract contract. This role is independent of thinking blocks and must fire unconditionally, unlike the reasoning reviewer which is skipped when thinking blocks are empty.
proposed_resolution: Create src/moeb/internal/roles/run-auditor.role.md with the observation-first two-pass design: Pass 1 observes the [RUN_STATE_SNAPSHOT] thinking block neutrally and lists deviations from the abstract contract; Pass 2 diagnoses each observation and emits RunStateAnomaly signals. The abstract contract defines: all written files committed before candidate tag, clean git status at tag time, tools returning type-consistent values, all signals filed and indexed. The role should be injected into canonical skills via {{run_auditor_persona}} template variable alongside the existing reviewer personas.
